title: Citi Premier CHANGES Coming | New Hotel Benefit & Bonus Categories
description: The Citi Premier has been a pretty good travel credit card, but Citi is updating the Premier with new bonus multipliers and a new hotel benefit. But all is not good, they remove one of the key benefits to this card as well. With these changes, is the Citi Premier credit card worth it? asr.full_text: Hey, what's going on everybody. I'm Waller's Wallet and Citi is making some changes to the Citi Premiere. So let's take a look at the changes and see if the Citi Premiere is a Card you should consider moving forward. Now if you're someone who want a simple way to help out the channel consider giving the video a thumbs up. Also, don't forget to hit that subscribe button and turn the bell on so you don't miss out on future videos. Now not too long ago Citi really did a number on their travel credit cards and pretty much removed all travel benefits across the board. Which I feel really hurt them. but even with that happening, their premiere was still a pretty decent card. Now, Citi has decided to make changes to their earnings as well as benefits on the premier card and these changes are happening in waves, but you know what, Kudos to Citi because they are giving people advanced notice of these changes and not implementing these without any notification. and for some of you these changes are going to be good... for others it's going to be less good. now if you're a coach Traveler then the first change is a big negative the city Premier is no longer going to have that 25% upift through the travel portal. points are going to be redeemed at 1 cent per points through the travel portal no longer going to be redeemed at one cent per point to their travel portal. No longer at one point two five cents per point, which I am not a fan of at all, but this change doesn't go into effect until April 10th of 2021. So once this change goes into effect, you're only going to get up to one cent per point through their travel portal. And really, that's not great. This pretty much kills the benefit of using their travel portal I guess the good news here if you want to consider it that is that this change is about a year out from now so you still have time to get that uplift from these points but at the time that these programme changes go into effect it will hurt the thank-you point programme since their partners while I think they are very good airline partners aren't for everyone, because they take more work to learn and use them, and so it was a nice bonus and incentive for people to use city portal for cheaper flights or maybe hotel options Remember this city portal isn't perfect, and we have seen price inflations on their portals in the past The next change comes to the Earning which goes into effect on august 23rd. now for current card holders who've had the premiere on or before april 9th. on august 23rd in addition to 3x on all travel and gas you're also going to start earning 3x on dining and 3x on supermarkets and you're still going to earn the 2x on entertainment and i think this makes the premier a pretty well-rounded card. And on April 10th of 2021, you're going to lose that 2x on entertainment and the travel category is no longer going to be as broad. When it comes to travel, you're only going to earn 3x on airfare and hotels, which really does hurt people who use this card for those other travel charges. But when you take a step back and look at premier's earnings, you're only going up one point per dollar for its dining rate which is one point and more that the no fee reward plus credit. So it's a nice addition to their card, but it's not earth shattering. Then if you open Pre on on or after April 10, your earning rates are going to change and go into effect on August 23. And until August 23, you're going to earn 3x on all travel and gas, 2x on restaurants and entertainment, and then 1x everywhere else. Then on August 23, you're only earning 3x on air fare, hotels, restaurant, supermarkets, and gas stations, and then 1x everywhere else. The 2x earning rates for entertainment is going away and travel will no longer be as broad. So Citi is going to give current cardholders of premier about 8 months of the added earning rates, which is a nice gesture from them. Then Citi is adding one time yearly benefit of a $100 hotel discount on hotels that saves $500 or more when you book through the city travel portal, and this is given each calendar year. This is also gonna be active starting August 23rd. Now you will need to prepay for your room with your City Premier, Thank you points, or a combination of them. And there are a few things to keep in mind about this hotel benefit. You can't use it on packages like flights and nights, or hotels and car rentals. You need to make the booking through the City Travel Portal or call City in order to make this reservation. And the big one is that you cannot combine this benefit with the prestigious fourth night free benefit. And I think it would have been great for City to let people who hold both card to combine these benefits. And I always like to tell you that if you're using the City Travel Portal or any other travel Portal for that option, hotels are not required to acknowledge your Elite status. So if you are someone with status and you want to use your Benefits, it's best to book with a hotel directly. If not, it's a your-miles-may-vary situation and we've also seen prices vary in those travel Portals so be sure to price compare. Now, if you're a current cardholder of the Premier and you're going to be getting these extra benefits starting on August 23rd, then I think this card is going to be a good option until that April timeframe when it changes. Because it is great to see Citi offer 3X on supermarkets and even increase the dining rate to 3X as well. And by offering 3X on supermarket, it at least offers some level of competition to American Express when it comes to groceries but i am not a fan of the broad travel categories being reduced to just airfare and hotels that makes this card more restricted for people since people do spend money on other travel categories outside of airfare hotels and as a coach flyer I don't like losing that 25% uplift through their travel portals. But I do think we all saw this coming at some point when they removed that uplift from the city prestige. And the $100 hotel benefit they're adding to the Premier just doesn't excite me since there are pricing variations between the portals and hotels. But if you're someone who spends a lot of money on gas, groceries, and dining, and uses city transfer partners, then this might look like it's an improvement for you. So, you know what? You tell me. What do you think of these changes? Hey, everyone, thanks for tuning in to this video. If you wanna help support the channel, a simple way would be links on the website or in the description below. And if you know someone who could benefit from the video, feel free to share it with them. And until next time, sip travel and take care.
